content.text: {"candidate_id":"v712-v712-qualification-q3-run-v712q3-accountancy-v5","content_hash":"23713d9976efdbd965b4ab9a01bd0b7af301920fd8672da51545f66daada8ce0","claims":[{"claim":"Interest on debentures is a charge on profits.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"It is payable even if there is no profit.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Option B is wrong because dividend, rather than debenture interest, is an appropriation of profits.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"The rate of interest on debentures is prefixed.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"The rate of return on shares may vary with company profits.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Option C is wrong because it says debenture interest varies with profits, contrary to the excerpt’s statement that its rate is prefixed.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Debentureholders do not normally enjoy voting rights.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Payment of interest on debentures is not conditional on debentureholders exercising voting rights.","basis":"excerpt"},{"claim":"Option D is wrong because it makes exercising voting rights a prerequisite for interest payment.","basis":"excerpt"}],"passed":true,"reasons":[],"evidence_ids":["E1.1","E1.2"],"resolution_audit":{"key":"A","key_fully_supported":true,"key_reason":"E1.1 states that debenture interest is a charge on profits and is payable even if there is no profit.","unexcluded_rival_conditions":[],"distractors":[{"option":"B","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"direct_contradiction","reason":"E1.1 distinguishes dividend appropriation from interest as a charge payable even when there is no profit."},{"option":"C","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"direct_contradiction","reason":"E1.1 says debenture interest is prefixed, not variable with company profits."},{"option":"D","decisively_wrong":true,"basis":"direct_contradiction","reason":"Interest is payable even without profit, while debentureholders normally lack voting rights; exercising votes is not a prerequisite."}]}}
